# jamfplatform_device_shutdown (Action)

Requests that Jamf Platform shut down a managed device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_device_shutdown" "power_off" {
  config {
    device_id = "uuid-of-device-to-shutdown"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) UUID of the device to shut down.
